description: Make the canonical grue object report authored colony evidence only after the Dead End colony has been physically revealed by strong light.

replacements.old:
<OBJECT GRUE
	(IN GLOBAL-OBJECTS)
	(SYNONYM GRUE)
	(ADJECTIVE LURKING SINISTER HUNGRY SILENT)
	(DESC "lurking grue")
	(ACTION GRUE-FUNCTION)>

<ROUTINE GRUE-FUNCTION ()
    <COND (<VERB? EXAMINE>
	   <TELL
"The grue is a sinister, lurking presence in the dark places of the
earth. Its favorite diet is adventurers, but its insatiable
appetite is tempered by its fear of light. No grue has ever been
seen by the light of day, and few have survived its fearsome jaws
to tell the tale." CR>)
	  (<VERB? FIND>
	   <TELL
"There is no grue here, but I'm sure there is at least one lurking
in the darkness nearby. I wouldn't let my light go out if I were
you!" CR>)
	  (<VERB? LISTEN>
	   <TELL
"It makes no sound but is always lurking in the darkness nearby." CR>)>>
replacements.new:
<OBJECT GRUE
	(IN GLOBAL-OBJECTS)
	(SYNONYM GRUE)
	(ADJECTIVE LURKING SINISTER HUNGRY SILENT)
	(DESC "lurking grue")
	(ACTION GRUE-FUNCTION)>

<ROUTINE GRUE-FUNCTION ()
    <COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DEAD-END-5>
                <GRUE-COLONY-REVEALED?>
                <VERB? EXAMINE>>
           <TELL
"You still cannot get a clean look at a grue. The torch proved only that
many separate shapes retreat through the mine fissures whenever strong
light reaches them. Whatever lives here has made a colony of the darkness,
not an exhibit of itself." CR>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DEAD-END-5>
                <GRUE-COLONY-REVEALED?>
                <VERB? FIND>>
           <TELL
"The fissures are the answer. Nothing remains in the light long enough to
be seen, but too many separate retreats have answered the torch for this to
be one lurking grue." CR>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DEAD-END-5>
                <GRUE-COLONY-REVEALED?>
                <VERB? LISTEN>>
           <TELL
"From different cracks come soft scrapes, tiny shifts of coal, and then
stillness. The sounds do not come from one place." CR>)
          (<VERB? EXAMINE>
	   <TELL
"The grue is a sinister, lurking presence in the dark places of the
earth. Its favorite diet is adventurers, but its insatiable
appetite is tempered by its fear of light. No grue has ever been
seen by the light of day, and few have survived its fearsome jaws
to tell the tale." CR>)
	  (<VERB? FIND>
	   <TELL
"There is no grue here, but I'm sure there is at least one lurking
in the darkness nearby. I wouldn't let my light go out if I were
you!" CR>)
	  (<VERB? LISTEN>
	   <TELL
"It makes no sound but is always lurking in the darkness nearby." CR>)>>
